Product Details: The DongCheng DZC02-20 Rotary Hammer is a powerful and versatile 20 mm professional power tool designed for demanding drilling applications. Powered by a robust 500W motor, it delivers an impact energy of 1.8 J and an impact rate of up to 4850 impacts per minute, making it ideal for drilling into concrete, steel, and wood. The tool features three operating modes — Drilling, Hammer Drilling, and Chiselling — allowing you to switch effortlessly between tasks using the easy-to-use mode selector. The SDS Plus tool holder enables fast and convenient bit changes, while the 360° adjustable auxiliary handle provides enhanced control and comfort during use. A variable speed trigger ensures precise control across different applications, and the lock-on button allows for continuous operation without fatigue. The lightweight design makes it especially suitable for horizontal and vertical upward drilling. Included in the package are three SDS Plus drill bits (6×160 mm, 8×160 mm, and 10×160 mm), a depth gauge, an auxiliary handle, and an extra pair of carbon brushes. Net weight is approximately 2.4 kg.
